about.title: About Me
about.shortBio: I'm a passionate web developer with a focus on creating engaging digital experiences.
about.longBio: I'm a passionate full-stack web developer with a strong foundation in Laravel, React.js, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, and modern web technologies. While I may not have years of professional experience yet, I've built several real-world projects that demonstrate my ability to design, develop, and debug full-featured applications from scratch. I specialize in creating clean, responsive, and user-friendly web apps, and I'm constantly learning new tools and best practices. Whether it's crafting efficient APIs with Laravel or building dynamic front-ends with React, I love bringing ideas to life through code.

items.title: Cars Selling Platform
items.description: A full-stack web application for buying and selling cars. Visitors can browse and explore available cars, while registered users can list their own vehicles for sale. The platform also includes features such as user authentication, adding cars to a wishlist, and an intuitive browsing experience.

items.title: Tasks Management App
items.description: A complete project and task management application with user management features. It allows teams or individuals to create projects, assign tasks, set deadlines, and track progress, providing a simple yet powerful way to stay organized and productive.

items.title: Multivendor E-commerce Store
items.description: A full-featured multivendor e-commerce platform built with Laravel, React, and Inertia.js. Supports product variations and variation options, vendor management, modern UI using Shadcn UI and Filament, integrated with Stripe for payments and Gemini API to help vendors generate product content effortlessly.

items.title: Advanced Stock Management System
items.description: A professional and complete stock management system built entirely with Laravel and Filament. It provides all the features needed for efficient inventory control, including product and category management, supplier and customer tracking, purchase and sales management, stock in/out operations, and real-time inventory monitoring. Advanced tools such as Excel/PDF reporting, role-based access control, and detailed user management with granular permissions ensure reliability and scalability for real-world business use.
